payload.text: **LESSON candidate, and a guard to propose (2026-09-19):** a full suite run with TMPDIR inside a git checkout (vc's tmp/vc/, inside Devbin itself) failed 51 tests. None were in the code under test: every one expects a fixture directory that is NOT a checkout, and each fixture sat inside the host repository. Nothing names the cause, and it reads like a regression. Proposal alongside todo 76(b): tests/lib/test_helper.bash refuses to run, by name, when $TMPDIR is inside a git work tree. Same class as 76: the suite inherits the operator's environment. Measured at 773bdd7: 1476 ok, 51 not ok with TMPDIR=tmp/vc/tfull773.
